Can Redwood provision a one-time promo batch for Horizon Analytics? Ideally: 120 codes, each 30-day trial + 5k token top-up. We also need the promo terms for legal (we'll publish a short blurb in the follow-up email).

Attached is the registrant list (email, full name, company) — we plan to seed codes via our email platform.

Sections we need from you:
- Confirmation of feasibility and timeline (can you deliver codes by Fri 9/17?)
- Any constraints (region locking, per-account caps)
- A single-line copy for our follow-up email and a short FAQ entry about expiration/transferability

Thanks,

What Redwood can provision:
- 120 unique trial codes (30-day trial + 5,000 token credit)
- Codes constrained to US region (we can expand but need a quick review for EU data residency)
- One redemption per account (we will enforce email-based dedupe at redemption)

Timeline: we can generate the batch and provide a CSV of codes by end of day Friday 2027-09-17 assuming we get final approval from our partnerships team (Marissa is looped). If you need a faster turnaround we can do a compressed 48-hour window but would require a signed promo terms acknowledgment (minor legal T&Cs).

Suggested one-line copy for your follow-up email:
"Claim a complimentary 30-day trial of Redwood Inference with 5,000 free tokens — exclusive to workshop waitlist attendees. Redeem by 10/22."

Suggested FAQ blurb:
"Codes are single-use, tied to the email they are issued to, valid for 30 days after activation. Tokens expire with the trial period and are non-transferable."

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you want the 120 codes and whether you require EU-capable codes (we'll need at least 48 hours extra).
2) If OK, Marissa, can you approve the promo allocation and any exception to our standard 30-day trial policy?

Thanks — I can draft the HubSpot upload CSV and the code file once approved.

Best,
